judgment_refs.note: Official aisle designation, contrasting marking or paving, adjacent designated accessible space, ingress/egress and route connectivity require independent sources; conditional 11.52.135(A) sign route requires sign details.
Vehicle, responsible person, occupancy, loading purpose and actual activity require independent review; no invented duration cutoff.
Public-access jurisdiction and premises context require independent original review.

sweep_specs.rationale: Synthetic diagnostics preserve source joins while official designation, public-access jurisdiction and parked classification remain open.
missing_inputs: Independent original premises, designation and parking sources.

cases.rationale: Observe premises context without targeting parking activity.
